name: Authorship Attribution Bias Reduction Benchmark
description: Evaluates methods for reducing dataset-induced bias in authorship attribution, measuring fairness and robustness of attribution models under biased conditions.
evaluation_method: accuracy for attribution plus fairness metrics (e.g., demographic parity gap, equalized odds) and robustness under biased/shifted data
general_score_metric: Composite: accuracy combined with fairness_gap (lower is better)
reputation: Emerging research benchmark in computational/forensic linguistics; limited but growing use in studies on bias mitigation for authorship attribution.
notes: High ethical/privacy sensitivity (risk of deanonymization); results can be dataset- and language-specific; small or imbalanced author cohorts may amplify bias signals.
